deadline.value: International applicants: January 8 for Fall (September) entry (Winter March 15, Summer August 1); rolling review.
deadline.quote: International applicants Term Annual application deadlines Fall (September) January 8 Winter (January) March 15 Summer (May) August 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for this field and the program page does not mention one.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for Earth Sciences applicants.
gre_general.quote: Statement of funding GRE (optional) The name of your preferred supervisor

supervisor.value: Name your preferred supervisor in the application; contacting a potential advisor first is encouraged and improves your chances.
supervisor.quote: We encourage you to contact a potential thesis advisor before submitting an application to ensure that there are openings for new graduate students on specific research projects and funding available for research support.

funding.value: Applicants submit a statement saying whether they need departmental financial assistance; no guaranteed stipend is stated.

entry_route.value: An MSc in earth sciences is the normal requirement; direct entry from an honours bachelor's is only for outstanding students.
entry_route.quote: The normal entry requirement is the equivalent of an MSc in earth sciences. | Direct entry into the PhD program from an honours bachelor’s degree is permitted only for outstanding students

notes: Three academic reference letters and a statement of funding are required.
